description.value: The Pemberton Hotel Pub is the in-house bar of the historic Pemberton Hotel, a building whose origins date to around 1914 when it served as a community hub for the Pacific Great Eastern railway era. Located on Frontier Street in the heart of Pemberton, it anchors the town centre alongside restaurants, cafes, and grocery stores within walking distance. Pemberton sits at the gateway to Sea-to-Sky mountain biking and backcountry terrain, making this pub a natural end-of-ride gathering spot for cyclists.
